item.title: Dilip Cherian | Foreign Service Or Forest? IFS In A Tizzy Over Acronym Wars
item.description: In 2016, the ministry of external affairs essentially told the forest fraternity: “We were born in 1946. You arrived in 1966. Seniority applies. Kindly relocate to IFoS.” It was the bureaucratic equivalent of “We were here first.”

item.title: AA Edit | Why Pick On Judiciary In School Textbooks?
item.description: It may be noted that the court is not dismissive of the whole idea of corruption in the judiciary; instead, as the CJI pointed out, the bench was “deeply hurt that there is no mention of the judiciary’s positive work — protection of civil rights, access to justice, free legal aid and safeguarding fundamental rights”. There was no attempt to present the students with a balanced picture, it said

item.title: AA Edit | Donald Trump Brazens It Out
item.description: Was any light shed on the issues that got him elected over the Democrat Kamala Harris in 2024, but which may have turned into susceptibilities ahead of the midterms? Probably not as tough immigration actions were the main reason the country may have been put off by its President, and he hardly spoke about them nor mentioned at least two Americans killed in ICE action even at the risk of alienating further those who are not in his MAGA fan base
